messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-4821 fired — p99 latency breach for inference-prod (eu-west). p99=1.82s, SLO=1.0s. Auto-page to oncall.
alex: acked — I'm on call and joining the thread :raised_hand: 
pagerduty-bot: alex acknowledged PD-4821
maria: looking at dashboards, p95 up but p99 exploding, 95->99 gap huge
raj: correlating with kvcache evictions and one very hot key on host gpu-23
erin: error rate stable, no spike in 5xxs. pure tail latency.
alex: running quick diagnostics, tails on hot hosts — ```kubectl exec -it pod/infer-hot-23 -- top -b -n1```
maria: kv eviction rate jumped at 02:14 UTC, matches start of spike
raj: stack shows long queueing in sidecar batching — some requests wait >200ms before send
alex: toggling batching qos to latency-first to flush queues (will reduce batching efficiency)
alex: command pasted to ops channel: ```redwoodctl config set inference.batch.policy=latency-first --region=eu-west```
maria: scaling dedicated pool +2 nodes to relieve hot placement pressure now
erin: can we try a quick model rollback on canary to rule out model change impact?
alex: initiating canary rollback v2.1 -> v2.0 for 10% traffic in eu-west now
raj: watching NVLink and GPU sched — hot host contention drops a bit after scale
maria: warming KV prefix for the hot key and enabling sharded reads as temp mitigation
alex: canary metrics: after 90s p99 on canary down to 0.95s :tada: (partial recovery)
erin: good signal. rolling to 50% canary over next 2m
alex: note: customer-visible impact limited to interactive features in eu-west, sessions slowed but not erroring. raising customer-impact flag low->medium
maria: creating incident ticket INC-4821 and adding initial timeline + mitigations https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821
raj: action items for postmortem: hotkey detection + auto-sharding, batching algorithm review, kvcache eviction tuning
sre-next: acknowledged handoff — I'll monitor for 2h and follow up if any re-burn occurs
alex: handing off to @sre-next in 15m. leaving notes in incident doc and runbook link
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4821 auto-resolved (metrics back under thresholds). Closing automated page.
maria: nice work team. will draft a short blameless postmortem and schedule follow-up with infra team
erin: +1, add suggested runbook step: immediate rollback canary + scale pool if p99>1.2s for >2m
raj: logging todo: implement hotkey alert (kvcache per-key QPS) and a throttling mitigation knob
alex: thanks all — closing thread, will append timeline and graphs to INC-4821 :white_check_mark:
